result:
All agents have returned and I've verified the key facts. Here are the answers:

---

**h01**: `s3presign.Runner` — 12-hour interval (`time.Ticker`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:162-163` (constructed and `RunOnce` called), with the ticker loop started in a goroutine at `server/server.go:166-171`.

**h02**: Delivery function — `Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual HTTP call at line 152 via `safeClient.Do(req)`). Protection mechanism — two-layer SSRF defense: (1) `ValidateURL` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62` checks resolved IPs against reserved CIDRs at registration time; (2) `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` re-checks IPs at dial time to defeat DNS rebinding. Reserved CIDRs defined at `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23`.

**h03**: Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct in `internal/idp/idp.go`); Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 protocol, in `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`).

**h04**: No; grepping for `mysql.NewDB` and `mysql.DB{` outside `store/db/db.go` (the factory) and the `store/db/mysql/` package itself in non-test code returns zero results. The MySQL driver is only ever constructed via `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go:22`.

**h05**: Explicit Go code; the `deleteUserTargetsTx` function in each driver (e.g., `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102`) calls both `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (removes reactions on the deleted user's memos, line ~380) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (removes reactions the user left on others' memos, line ~400). No CASCADE constraints are used. Same pattern in `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go` and `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go`.

**h06**: Handlers: (1) `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), (2) `UpdateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401`), (3) `DeleteMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`), (4) `CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`), (5) `SetMemoAttachments` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16`), (6) `SetMemoRelations` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16`). Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.

**h07**:
- `serveUserAvatar` (HTTP handler) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks `userCache`, on miss calls `ListUsers`)
- `Store.ListUsers` → `driver.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:137` → `store/driver.go:47`
- `DB.ListUsers` (concrete, e.g., SQLite) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go` (executes SQL)
- `parseDataURI` (decodes avatar data URI) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`

**h08**: Two declarers:
- `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked: yes — callers: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`) and self-call from `Runner.Run` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked: no (no production caller found)

**h09**: 6 distinct declarations of `Close`:
1. `SSEHub.Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`
2. `Store.Close` — `store/store.go:72`
3. `Cache.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187`
4. `sqlite.DB.Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`
5. `postgres.DB.Close` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`
6. `mysql.DB.Close` — `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`

All 6 are reachable from production code. `SSEHub.Close` called by `Server.closeLongLivedConnections` (`server/server.go:206`). `Store.Close` called by `Server.Shutdown` (`server/server.go:146`). `Store.Close` in turn calls `Cache.Close` on 3 cache instances (`store/store.go:74-76`) and `driver.Close()` (`store/store.go:78`) which dispatches to whichever DB driver is active.

**h10**: `filter.DefaultEngine` — `internal/filter/engine.go` — approx 7 callers (tied with `util.GenUUID` at 7; `DefaultEngine` spans more packages: `server/router/api/v1`, `store/db/sqlite`, `store/db/postgres`, `store/db/mysql`).

**h11**: 1st: `Memo` (referenced from ~8-9 packages outside the store layer, including `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`, `internal/markdown`, `server/notification`, `server/router/frontend`, `server`); 2nd: `User` (referenced from ~7-8 packages, including `server/auth`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`, `server/notification`, `server/router/frontend`, `server`).

**h12**: Concrete method: `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`. Determination: `cmd/memos/main.go:122` sets `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`, so with no flags the profile driver is `"sqlite"`, which causes `store/db/db.go:20` (`NewDBDriver` switch) to instantiate `sqlite.NewDB`. `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109`) delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`, which resolves to the SQLite implementation.

**h13**: Implementation: unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` (wraps goldmark). Construction: `markdown.NewService()` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` (with tag and mention extensions). Holders of the `markdown.Service` interface: `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), and `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`).

**h14**: Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:355`). Triggers: (1) `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), (2) `UpdateMemo` when content changes (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`). Extracted properties: `Tags` (hashtags), `Property.Title` (first H1 heading text), `Property.HasLink`, `Property.HasCode`, `Property.HasTaskList`, `Property.HasIncompleteTasks`.

**h15**:
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (GetMemo, parent memo) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` visibility filtering — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- `ListMemoComments` visibility — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148-161`
- `ListMemoReactions` visibility — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-41`
- `UpsertMemoReaction` visibility — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:60-85`
- `ListMemoAttachments` visibility — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-225`
- `checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:419-455`
- File server attachment serving — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:674-703`
- RSS feeds (public-only filter) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`
- Sitemap (public-only) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- Memo relations filtering — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:108-112`
- Memo relation converter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:182-187`

**r01**: False premise. There is no Redis in the codebase. The cache layer (`store/cache/cache.go`) is a pure in-memory cache using Go's `sync.Map` with TTL-based expiration. Default TTL is 10 minutes, cleanup interval is 5 minutes, max 1000 items.

**r02**: False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware in the codebase. No rate limiter, throttle, or request-limit implementation exists for API endpoints.

**r03**: False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup job. While an `internal/scheduler` package exists, it is not used by any production code — no jobs are registered in `server/server.go` or anywhere else.

**r04**: False premise. Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhook delivery uses an in-process Go buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:30`) with 4 goroutine workers draining it — no external message broker.

**r05**: False premise. There is no GraphQL schema. The API is defined using Protocol Buffers/gRPC (proto files in `proto/api/v1/`), served over HTTP via ConnectRPC (`connectrpc.com/connect` in `go.mod`) with gRPC-gateway support.
